#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
WS="$HOME/.openclaw/workspace"
cd "$REPO"

# Refresh curated private context snapshots before committing.
[ -f "$WS/USER.md" ] && cp -p "$WS/USER.md" "$REPO/people/USER.md"
[ -f "$WS/context/USER_PREFERENCES.md" ] && cp -p "$WS/context/USER_PREFERENCES.md" "$REPO/people/USER_PREFERENCES.md"
[ -f "$WS/context/OPERATING_RULES.md" ] && cp -p "$WS/context/OPERATING_RULES.md" "$REPO/OPERATING_RULES.md"
[ -f "$WS/context/WORK_CONTEXT.md" ] && cp -p "$WS/context/WORK_CONTEXT.md" "$REPO/people/WORK_CONTEXT.md"
[ -f "$WS/DREAMS.md" ] && cp -p "$WS/DREAMS.md" "$REPO/state/DREAMS.md"

python3 "$REPO/scripts/backup-runtime-state.py" >/dev/null

git add -A
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  exit 0
fi

git commit -m "Auto-save Samantha private context $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
git pull --rebase origin main
git push origin main

link-runtime.sh.code:
#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
WS="$HOME/.openclaw/workspace"

mkdir -p "$WS/memory/whatsapp"
mkdir -p "$WS/memory/voice"

backup_if_regular() {
  local p="$1"
  if [ -e "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]; then
    mv "$p" "$p.pre-private-repo-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  else
    rm -f "$p"
  fi
}

backup_if_regular "$WS/memory/amine-inbox.md"
backup_if_regular "$WS/memory/contacts.md"
backup_if_regular "$WS/memory/voice/amine.md"

if [ -e "$WS/memory/whatsapp/contacts" ] && [ ! -L "$WS/memory/whatsapp/contacts" ]; then
  mv "$WS/memory/whatsapp/contacts" "$WS/memory/whatsapp/contacts.pre-private-repo-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
else
  rm -f "$WS/memory/whatsapp/contacts"
fi

ln -s "$REPO/whatsapp/inbox/amine-inbox.md" "$WS/memory/amine-inbox.md"
ln -s "$REPO/whatsapp/contacts-index.md" "$WS/memory/contacts.md"
ln -s "$REPO/whatsapp/contacts" "$WS/memory/whatsapp/contacts"
ln -s "$REPO/voice/amine.md" "$WS/memory/voice/amine.md"

echo "Private WhatsApp and voice context linked into runtime."
